object_description: narrow three-story addition with a compact rectangular volume
design_condition: The additional volume follows the existing slender-building rhythm along the northeastern slope edge, preserving the flowing landscape and southeast open space while improving the entrance forecourt.

positive.statement: The new building is logically derived from the existing structure and preserves the quality of the flowing landscape.
The interventions in the existing substance are limited to a minimum and integrate into the protected building structure.
The simple, axially symmetrical floor plans offer good flexibility and appropriation options.
Combining the day and all-day school in one building has interesting operational advantages.
The structure and floor plans are clean and efficient.

negative.statement: The new building undesirably obscures the existing complex.
Clusters with more than two classes can only be formed to a limited extent.
The stairwell offers hardly any spatial qualities and does not meet fire-protection requirements.
The underground gymnasium has insufficient natural lighting and negative static and economic effects.
The small window proportion calls achievement of the energy requirements into question.
